method: sheet tool; all 9 sweep crops r0c0..r2c2 at 2x viewed; contact sheets csA-csD (8x, +/-25 px), csD2 (5x, +/-45 px pheon search), csE (12x), nnA (12x nearest+bicubic) viewed; marker sheet viewed after writing. Every crop and contact sheet displayed when opened. csF (10x) re-zoom; three positions corrected by 2-11 px after the marker sheet.
legibility: clean print but Green Street is lined with large boundary dots and interpunct lettering, so most figures there have no distinguishable survey dot; vertical sheet join at px ~165 over the full height confirmed by eye (tint change and straight line), no figure crosses it; 3/5/8/9 separation weak
